title: Strive (ASST) Buys No Bitcoin Last Week, Holdings Stay at 43,404 BTC
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strive (ASST) Buys No Bitcoin Last Week, Holdings Stay at 43,404 BTC Strive bought no bitcoin and sold no stock last week, leaving holdings at 43,404 BTC, its Monday 8-K shows. ASST shares traded near $15.55. This post Strive (ASST) Buys No Bitcoin Last Week, Holdings Stay at 43,404 BTC first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
